test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The children were / bubbling with excitement / at the thought of / seeing sea.
solution:
The correct answer is "**seeing sea**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**seeing sea**" is **missing an article**.
 
• An **article** gives **information** about the** noun** by coming** in front** of it.
 
• As the sentence **denotes** a **specific sea**, the article "**the**" must be used. 
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase will be "**seeing the sea**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Articles** are divided into **definite and indefinite articles.**
 
• "**The**" is the **definite article** as it denotes the **particular noun**.
 
 
• **Example:** *Let us eat from **the shop** near our school.* 
 
 
 
• **"A"** and **"an"** are** indefinite articles** as they denote **any noun. **
 
• **"A"** is used before a noun that does **not begin with a vowel sound**.
 
 
• **Example:** *Mike is **a teacher. ***
 
 
 
• **"An"** is used before a noun **beginning with a vowel sound.** 
 
 
• **Example: ***Elly saw **an elephant** yesterday. *
